> KivoPad is a custom macropad running on ZMK firmware featuring 14 mechanical switches with hot-swap sockets and  2 encoders. The switches can be programmed to any action and thanks to ZMK the whole macropad is wireless.

## Design

### 2026-11-07: First entry,

**5.68h**

First entry,

Started by creating a new project and finding all of the needed components on LCSC. After that created the microcontroller design and footprint, found and added the 3D model. Laid out the schematic and connected everything. After that transferred everything into the PCB editor and placed the components in the needed places. After that routed the board. Added some text and project link to the PCB and that's it!

[Timelapse](https://lookout.hackclub.com/api/media/dc5bc019-efae-4d72-a863-5ea82e6535f9/video.mp4)

### 2026-11-08: Second entry,

**3.75h**

Second entry,

Started by creating a new project in Fusion. Imported the PCB .step file and stated the case design. Made the outer case, added the switch holder, encoder holes, encoder knobs and the lid. Finished the case with heatset  insert spots and microcontroller type-c cutout.

And that's it!

[Timelapse](https://lookout.hackclub.com/api/media/c7332228-48d9-4f65-b1fb-7eca3833b295/video.mp4)

### 2026-11-08: Third entry,

**0.25h**

Third entry,

Started by fixing the microcontroller 3D file placement. After that exported the Gerber, Pick and Place, PCB BOM, PCB image, PCB 3D image, Schematic in PDF and SVG, Altium designer files including the project and the Schematic and the main project file.

And that's it!

[Timelapse](https://lookout.hackclub.com/api/media/78db496b-c6e2-4e76-9e85-6fad34fdc718/video.mp4)
